steps.name: strict PyTorch parity
steps.expr: const close=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<1e-9;const c=DATA.checks;const a=COPIED.alignment;const bad=[];for(const e of c.dpo){if(!close(a.dpoLoss(...e.input).loss,e.loss))bad.push("DPO");}for(const e of c.grpo){const out=a.advantages(e.rewards);if(!out.every((v,i)=>close(v,e.advantages[i])))bad.push("GRPO");}for(const e of c.lora){if(COPIED.peft.trainable("lora",{r:e.rank})!==e.trainable)bad.push("LoRA");}return bad.length?"FAIL "+bad.join(", "):"PASS: DPO/GRPO 1e-9, LoRA exact";

steps.name: BERT transfer selection and measured results
steps.expr: const q=s=>document.querySelector(s),B=DATA.bertTransfer,T=B.transfer; if(!q('#p-bert-transfer-results').hidden)throw Error('results visible before reveal');for(const [key,r] of Object.entries(T.runs)){q('#p-bert-transfer-modes [data-k="'+key+'"]').click();const top=r.top_blocks==='all'?B.layers:r.top_blocks;const count=document.querySelectorAll('#p-bert-transfer-fig [data-part="block"][data-trainable="true"]').length;if(count!==top)throw Error('blocks '+key);if(q('#p-bert-transfer-fig [data-part="embeddings"]').dataset.trainable!==String(r.top_blocks==='all'))throw Error('embeddings '+key);if(!q('#p-bert-transfer-stats').textContent.includes(r.trainable_params.toLocaleString('ru-RU')))throw Error('parameters '+key);if(!q('#p-bert-transfer-results').hidden)throw Error('selection leaked results');}q('#p-btn-bert-transfer-reveal').click();for(const [key,r] of Object.entries(T.runs)){q('#p-bert-transfer-modes [data-k="'+key+'"]').click();const cells=q('#p-bert-transfer-table tr.hl').cells; if(cells[1].textContent!==r.trainable_params.toLocaleString('ru-RU'))throw Error('table parameters');if(cells[3].textContent!==(100*r.accuracy.at(-1)).toFixed(2)+'%')throw Error('accuracy');if(cells[4].textContent!==r.seconds.at(-1).toLocaleString('ru-RU'))throw Error('time');if(q('#p-bert-transfer-result').textContent.indexOf(cells[3].textContent)<0)throw Error('selected result');}if(q('#p-kumar-details').open||q('#p-bet-kumar-id'))throw Error('article bets remain');q('#p-bert-transfer-modes button').click();return 'PASS: four modes, frozen layers, hidden results, artifact parameters/accuracy/time';

steps.name: questions follow their topics
steps.expr: const at=(key,id)=>{const q=document.querySelector('[data-q="'+key+'"]');if(q.closest('section').id!==id)throw Error('misplaced '+key);};at('q-ppo-trained','a-pref');at('q-ppo-clip','a-pref');at('q-grpo-flat','a-rlvr');at('q-methods','policy');if(document.querySelectorAll('#policy .qz').length!==1)throw Error('unrelated questions in summary');for(const id of ['policy','design','sources'])if(!document.getElementById(id).closest('main .wrap'))throw Error('outside layout: '+id);const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('[id]')].map(n=>n.id);if(new Set(ids).size!==ids.length)throw Error('duplicate IDs');return 'PASS: PPO and GRPO questions are in their own blocks';

steps.name: quiz answers and persistence
steps.expr: for(const q of Object.values(QUIZ.data)){const h=document.querySelector('[data-q="'+q.key+'"]');if(q.type==='pick'||q.type==='point'){for(const o of q.opts.filter(o=>o.right))h.querySelector('[data-k="'+o.k+'"]').click();h.querySelector('.qz-check')?.click();}else if(q.type==='sort'){[...h.querySelectorAll('tr')].forEach((tr,i)=>{[...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.dataset.b===q.items[i].bins[0]).click();});h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}else if(q.type==='write'){h.querySelector('textarea').value='проверка';h.querySelector('textarea').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();}if(!h.classList.contains('done'))throw Error('not finished '+q.key);if(h.querySelector('.qz-verdict.no'))throw Error('wrong grading '+q.key);}const key='quiz:'+document.querySelector('meta[name="quiz-store"]').content;const state=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key));if(Object.values(state).filter(s=>s.done).length!==Object.keys(QUIZ.data).length)throw Error('persistence');return document.querySelector('#quiz-progress').textContent;

steps.name: quiz and board mode
steps.expr: const total=document.querySelectorAll(".qz").length;QUIZ.reset();document.getElementById("btn-present").click();const visible=[...document.querySelectorAll(".prose.slide")].every(p=>getComputedStyle(p).display!=="none");document.getElementById("btn-present").click();return total+" questions, reset OK, board theses visible: "+visible;
